0022600020.text: The Miami Heat (0-4, on a four-game losing streak and 0-3 at home) host the Indiana Pacers (2-2, 8th in the East, 1 game back of 3rd place in the Central) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game. Miami is without Simone Fontecchio (illness), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after Miami lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 135-118 loss in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
